I worry sometimes that I have not been a good mum to my children because I spend much less time with them compared to other mums that work less.
</message>
output: You bear the weight of your own judgment, yet the measure of a mother is not the hours spent but the love given. Remember that virtue lies in the intention of your heart, not in the comparison of your schedule. Strive to be present in spirit, even when your body is occupied, for the love you offer is what truly nourishes your children.
